get.summary:
GET /i18n/bundle/:lang?since=version. Bypasses the global
ResponseInterceptor's {data:...} envelope deliberately (@Res()
without `passthrough`, per Nest's documented raw-response-control
pattern) — that's the only way to send a spec-correct empty-body 304
for a matching ETag (docs/01_FOUNDATION_AUTH.md §9.3: "Поддержка
ETag/304"). Every other route in this module returns normally and
gets the standard envelope.

ETag/304 is the plain-GET HTTP-cache path (no `since`): if the
client's If-None-Match matches the language's current version, 304
with no body. `since` is the separate, explicit delta-poll path
(§9.3: "полный или дельта-набор + version") — it always returns 200
with a (possibly empty) JSON body, never a 304, since it's a
versioned query the client is actively asking for, not a cache
revalidation.

info.title: LawBid API
info.description: LawBid — US legal-services marketplace. Every 2xx JSON body is the envelope {data, meta?: {nextCursor}} and every error is {error: {code, message, details?, requestId}} with `code` from the ErrorCode enum — docs/01_FOUNDATION_AUTH.md §7.

message.description: Human-readable, not localized and not stable — never branch on it.

app_config.description: Public app_config values (min versions, store URLs, ...).

translations_version.description: Current bundle version per language code.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; null on the last page.

sent.description: Always true: the code was sent.

linkChallenge.description:
Magic-link binding (email login only): base64url SHA-256 of a random
verifier that stays on the requesting device. The emailed link then
carries a one-time token redeemable only together with that verifier
(POST /auth/otp/verify-link), so a leaked link is useless. Omit it and
the email contains the code only.

refreshToken.description: Opaque rotating refresh token; store in secure storage only.

isNewUser.description: True when this call created the account.

sessionId.description: Session chain id (stable across refresh rotations) — the id DELETE /auth/sessions/{id} takes.

isCurrent.description: True for the session making this request.

reauthToken.description: Single-use token for the X-Reauth-Token header of a sensitive action; expires after REAUTH_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS (5 min).

data.description: Free-form step-local UI data, merged on every PATCH (always a JSON object: SaveOnboardingStepDto.data is @IsObject).

licensedStates.description: Attorney only: USPS codes of licensed states.

avatarUrl.description: Short-lived signed link to the avatar (1024 px JPEG).

profile.description: Null before the profile step is saved (or without a role).

value.description: Phone (E.164) or email; null for apple/google.

isPrimaryContact.description: True for the phone/email that is the account's contact.

avatarFileId.description:
docs/03 §4.1 photo (OQ-012 attorney onboarding photo step): a clean
`avatar` file from POST /files/presign + confirm; null removes it.

licensedStates.description:
Attorney: states where they hold a license (multi-select). Bar
numbers are collected on verification (docs/03), so these are not
attorney_licenses rows yet.

data.description:
Free-form step-local UI data. Merged, not replaced. Profile fields
belong in [profile], which lands in client_profiles /
attorney_profiles.

profile.description:
The profile step's structured fields (docs/01 §11 3A/3B), upserted
into the role's profile table in the same transaction as the step.

sent.description: Always true: the code was sent.

url.description: POST target (multipart/form-data): send every field, then the file as the last field named "file".

fields.description: Form fields signed by the server (key, policy, signature, Content-Type).

expiresAt.description: The upload link expires at (5 minutes).

mime.description: One of: image/jpeg, image/png, image/heic, application/pdf (allowed set depends on purpose).

sizeBytes.description: Exact size of the file in bytes.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file.

ScanStatus.description: Only `clean` files can be attached (avatar, verification, posts).

mime.description: Real type (magic bytes); HEIC becomes image/jpeg once processed.

scanStatus.description: Only `clean` files can be attached (avatar, verification, posts).

url.description: Short-lived signed link — only for clean avatar/post images. Verification files are never served to the app (docs/03 §2.2).

version.description: Current bundle version; send it back as `since`.

translations.description: key -> text. Full bundle without `since`; only keys changed after `since` with it (empty when up to date).

applied.description: True only for a valid `apply` run.

additionalStateCodes.description: 0-2 more states, distinct from the primary and each other.

budgetAmountDollars.description: Required (and only meaningful) when budgetMode = amount.

clientContactSharingConsent.description: Must be true unless the client already granted client_contact_sharing on an earlier case.

avg.description: Average of published reviews, 0 if none.

avatarUrl256.description: Signed link to the 256 px avatar; null when none.

contactNote.description: The client’s note on when to be contacted.

disclosedAt.description: When the contacts were first disclosed (the accept transaction, §8.2).

confirmedReports.description: The client's confirmed reports after this decision (all cases).

clientSuspended.description: True when this decision reached contacts.suspend_after_confirmed_reports and suspended the client.

clientName.description: Client name; null while the subscription is inactive (contacts are locked, §8.3).

available.description: false → "Кейс недоступен" (closed or no longer visible).

amountCents.description: Required for fixed/hourly; ignored (stored as 0) for free_consultation.

startDate.description: Required when startAvailability = custom_date; not past.

deleted.description: The case was deleted from the feed.

acceptedBid.description: The accepted bid; for an attorney only when it is their own bid.

url.description: Signed download link, valid 10 minutes (status ready).

licenses.description: All of the attorney's licenses with their status.

request.description: The latest request, or null if none yet.

identityRequired.description: Identity document and selfie are required (false for an already verified attorney adding a state, §2.1).

expiresAt.description: License expiry (YYYY-MM-DD), if the license has one.

side.description: Identity documents: front/back (back required for drivers_license and state_id).

stateCode.description: bar_license: the state of the license it proves.

stateCodes.description: States of the licenses under review.

autoCheckResult.description: Latest automatic bar lookup (§2.4), null if none ran.

history.description: The attorney's other requests, newest first.

requestId.description: The request the license was queued in for manual review, null when the lookup passed.

i18nKey.description: Translation key of the display name.

verifiedBadge.description: Blue check (docs/03 §6.3): verified status and at least one verified license.

usernameNextChangeAt.description: When the username may be changed again; null = it can be changed now.

username.description:
3-30 latin letters, digits, `_` and `.`; not starting/ending with
`.`/`_`; no `..`. Uniqueness is case-insensitive.

avatarUrl256.description: Signed link to the 256 px square variant; null when none.

isSelf.description: True when this is the caller's own profile.

authorDisplayName.description: Reviewer as "First L." (docs/03 §7.4); null when the account has no name (show a localized placeholder).

editedAt.description: Set when the client edited the review ("Edited" label).

editableUntil.description: Last moment the client may edit (created + review.edit_window_days).

editable.description: True while PATCH /reviews/:id is allowed: still published and before editableUntil.

authorDisplayName.description: Reviewer as "First L." (docs/03 §7.4); null when the account has no name (show a localized placeholder).

editedAt.description: Set when the client edited the review ("Edited" label).
